review_scope: Manually reviewed every nonblank SDR Comments field among 331 local reports and every GWDB remark matching dry/abandon/plug/quality/insufficient/destroy/collapse/failure terms among 386 local records. Reviewed contextual ambiguities against complete remarks. These overrides concern outcome wording only; preserve all numeric tests, dates, source fields, and quality indicators. No current-success classification is justified.

method_notes: No missing or zero-placeholder yields were promoted to dry status.
Reconditioning and test-well records are not independent new water-supply drilling trials.
No case-insensitive dry keyword in an address, owner name or water-bearing formation should be used to classify outcome.
A reported positive yield is evidence at the date of its report, not proof of present sustainability or potability.

historical_supplement.summary: R323 reports 15-18 gpm but abandonment in the early 1980s and water described as unsuitable for drinking. Current extract only says unused and reports jetted yield. Show this as a separate historical report assertion if used; do not replace current source remarks.
